name: helper-callable-uses
goal: Only actual helper calls appear in a selected helper Uses tab; empty Uses is absent

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Callable contract selection retains module-wide relations. Scope selected helper Uses to exact named caller facts; hide empty helper Uses and route legacy empty Uses to overview.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing callable contract and relation tests never combine independent sibling helpers with module dependencies. Extend their shared callable fixture and browser matrix for exact helper calls and empty Uses.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed regression 27d337b2d fails the named Uses visibility assertion at desktop/tablet/mobile; retained focused screenshots and immutable red record.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Resolve Uses from exact helper consumer caller symbols; retain private pure callees as callable cards; omit empty Uses tabs and render Overview for legacy empty Uses URLs. Update contracts and Harness skill.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged 27d337b2d regression passes at 0cf94eac5: three current/historical desktop/tablet/mobile browser cases and five component cases, with retained images and contextual runtime/memory observations. Full CLI/native suites remain deferred.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
